paragraphs.text: Balan , Wandering Knight is a legendary cat knight from an unknown plane .

Balan is a solitary leonin warrior who loves the thrill of being the wandering hero. She'll pounce into battle to defend the innocent or slay an evil beast. She has many a tale of adventure, and will happily share them if there's a crackling fire and warm drink involved.
She is also a renowned weapon master.
